asr.full_text: Hey guys, today we're going to be talking about how to change your default search. Engine in the Firefox web browser. So what you're going to want to do to. Change the default search engine that will be used in like this search bar. Here or if you type in a search in the location bar, we're gonna click on these. Three horizontal lines here and it'll open up this page and we're gonna click. On options and then we're going to click on this search tab right here and then. Here you'll see that it says default search engine and right now I have. Google set as my default search in this drop-down you can choose which of these.
